howItWorksPage.title: How it works
howItWorksPage.subtitle: One platform, two journeys. See exactly what happens from sign-up to your first day together — whether you're a family or a nanny.

parents.intro: From telling us what your family needs to enjoying a fully managed placement — here is every step, in order.

register.title: Create your account
register.desc: Register as a family with your contact details and location. Verify your email or phone and you're ready to go.

describeNeeds.title: Tell us what you need
describeNeeds.desc: Search our verified nannies yourself, or submit a request describing your children's ages, schedule, live-in/live-out preference and budget.

match.title: We shortlist and interview
match.desc: Our admin team searches verified profiles, invites the best matches, and runs interviews on your behalf — no back-and-forth for you.

approve.title: Meet your recommended nanny
approve.desc: We recommend one to three candidates with a full profile summary and interview notes. Approve your favourite, or ask us for other options.

sign.title: Sign the contract online
sign.desc: Once approved, we generate your family service contract. Review it and sign electronically — or in person — directly on the platform.

relax.title: Enjoy the peace of mind
relax.desc: Your nanny starts on schedule. We handle monthly payments, receipts, and support for as long as the placement lasts.

nanny.intro: From building your profile to getting paid every month — here is every step of joining the platform as a nanny.

register.title: Create your account
register.desc: Register as a nanny with your contact details and location, and verify your email or phone number.

buildProfile.title: Build your profile
buildProfile.desc: Add your experience, age-group specialities, skills and availability, then upload your ID photo and any certificates or references.

getVerified.title: Get verified by our team
getVerified.desc: Submit your profile for review. An admin checks your documents and either approves you or asks for a quick correction.

invitations.title: Receive interview invitations
invitations.desc: When a family's needs match your profile, you'll be invited to an interview — with no family contact details shared until you're placed.

signContract.title: Get recommended and sign
signContract.desc: If the family approves you, we prepare your work contract with your salary, schedule and duties. Sign it online in a few clicks.

getPaid.title: Start working and get paid
getPaid.desc: Begin the placement on your agreed start date. The platform pays you every month and keeps a full record of your payment history.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
intro: Welcome to First Moments Childcare Angola.
These Terms & Conditions explain the terms that apply when you visit our website, request our services, or make a booking with us.
By using our website or booking our services, you agree to these Terms & Conditions.

blocks.text: First Moments Childcare Angola is a professional childcare service connecting families with carefully selected childcare professionals.
Our services may include:

items: Other childcare services agreed with the family

blocks.text: Services and availability may vary depending on location and caregiver availability.
A service request submitted through our website does not automatically constitute a confirmed booking.
A booking is confirmed once:

items: We have received the information required to arrange the service
A suitable caregiver has been identified and accepted
The booking details have been confirmed
Any required payment or deposit has been received

blocks.text: We reserve the right to decline a booking if we cannot provide a suitable caregiver or if the requested service falls outside our scope.
Parents or legal guardians are responsible for providing accurate and complete information about the child.
This may include information regarding:
Please inform us immediately if any important information changes.
Providing incomplete or inaccurate information may affect our ability to provide safe and appropriate care.
We aim to select caregivers based on experience, suitability, availability and the requirements of each position.
Our screening process may include:
The specific screening requirements may vary depending on the position.
While we take reasonable steps to select suitable caregivers, screening cannot guarantee that an incident will never occur.
The safety and wellbeing of children is central to our service.
First Moments has a zero-tolerance approach to:
Any serious safeguarding concern will be taken seriously and may be reported to the appropriate authorities where required or appropriate.
Parents and guardians agree to:

items: Provide accurate information about their child
Inform us of relevant health and safety concerns
Provide necessary food, clothing, medication and child-related items
Provide a safe environment for the caregiver
Treat caregivers with dignity and respect
Pay agreed fees within the specified timeframe
Follow our booking and cancellation procedures

blocks.text: All applicable fees will be communicated to the Client before a booking is confirmed.
The price may depend on factors such as:
Additional hours or special requests may incur additional fees.
Our cancellation and rescheduling conditions will be communicated during the booking process.
Cancellation fees may apply depending on how close to the scheduled service the cancellation is made.
We may consider genuine emergencies on a case-by-case basis.
If a caregiver becomes unavailable, we will make reasonable efforts to provide a suitable replacement.
However, we cannot guarantee that a replacement will always be available, particularly for last-minute bookings.
If we are unable to provide an appropriate replacement, the Client may be offered a refund or service credit in accordance with our booking policy.
Caregivers are scheduled according to the agreed booking time.
If additional childcare is required, the Client must request the additional time through First Moments whenever possible.
Additional hours may be subject to availability and additional charges.
Transportation is not included in standard childcare services unless specifically agreed in advance.
A caregiver will not transport a child without the necessary authorization and an approved arrangement.
Our caregivers are not medical professionals unless specifically engaged and qualified for a medical role.
In the event of an emergency, a caregiver may contact emergency services and the child's designated emergency contact.
Parents should provide relevant emergency and medical information before the service begins.
We respect the privacy of children and families.
We will not use photographs or videos of a child for our marketing, advertising or social media without appropriate parental or legal-guardian consent.
Information shared with First Moments in connection with childcare services is treated as confidential.
This may include:
Information will only be disclosed where appropriate, authorized, legally required, or necessary to protect someone's safety.
Caregivers introduced to families through First Moments are part of our professional network.
If a family wishes to permanently employ or directly contract a caregiver introduced through First Moments, the family must contact us regarding our applicable placement process and fees.
We encourage families to contact us as soon as possible if they have a concern about our service or a caregiver.
We may investigate concerns and take appropriate action, which may include:
You agree to use our website lawfully and responsibly.
You must not:

items: Attempt to interfere with website security
Use the website for fraudulent purposes
Misuse our brand, logo or materials

blocks.text: The First Moments name, logo, website design, written content, photographs, graphics and other original materials are protected by applicable intellectual-property laws.
They may not be copied, reproduced or commercially used without our prior written permission.
We may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time.
When we make changes, we will update the "Last updated" date at the top of this page.
These Terms & Conditions are intended to operate in accordance with the applicable laws of the Republic of Angola.
Where a dispute cannot be resolved directly between the parties, it may be referred to the appropriate competent authority or court.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.placeholderNotice: This is placeholder text pending review by a licensed lawyer in Angola, including compliance with Angola's data protection law (Lei n.º 22/11). Do not treat it as final legal language.

sections.heading: 1. Information we collect
sections.body: We collect the information you provide at registration (name, contact details, city/province), nanny profile details (experience, availability, salary expectations), and documents nannies upload for verification (ID, references, certificates, and — with explicit consent — medical records).

sections.heading: 2. How we use it
sections.body: We use this information to run matching, schedule interviews, generate contracts, record payments and send you notifications about your account and placements.

sections.heading: 3. Who can see what
sections.body: ID documents and medical records are visible to our admin team only — never to families. Certificates and references may be shown to families as a “Verified” badge without the underlying files. Nanny contact details (email, phone, WhatsApp) are never shared with families; all communication is routed through the platform.

sections.heading: 4. Third-party services
sections.body: We use Brevo to send transactional emails and SMS, and Cloudinary to store uploaded documents and photos. These providers process data on our behalf and do not use it for their own purposes.

sections.heading: 5. Data retention
sections.body: We retain account and placement data for as long as your account is active, and as required to meet legal and accounting obligations afterwards.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
sections.body: You may request a copy of your data, ask us to correct it, or request account deletion by contacting us through the Contact page.

sections.heading: 7. Contact
sections.body: Questions about this policy can be sent through our Contact page.
